title: A groupoid model for Rørdam's finite-infinite $C^*$-algebra
summary: We construct a groupoid model for Rordam's example of a simple, nuclear, separable $C^*$-algebra containing a finite and an infinite projection. This groupoid model arises from a (crossed product of a) carefully chosen model for the inductive limit construction in Rordam's original approach, which we show to yield a Cartan subalgebra of the limit.
